name: Cimmerian-Esker
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by a nearby asteroid belt. Beyond bioluminescent seas, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
the derelict space station in orbit still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
